crew.overview: Recently fired and desperate for work, a troubled young man named Mike agrees to take a position as a night security guard at an abandoned theme restaurant: Freddy Fazbear's Pizzeria. But he soon discovers that nothing at Freddy's is what it seems.
crew.title: Five Nights at Freddy's

details.biography: Emma Tammi (born February 26, 1982) is an American filmmaker, actress and the co-founder of Mind Hive Films. She is best known for directing the horror films The Wind (2018), Five Nights at Freddy's (2023) and Five Nights at Freddy's 2 (2025).
details.name: Emma Tammi
details.place_of_birth: New York City, New York, USA
